en: Fixed the agent panel footer offering "Enter to view" and "x to stop" on the agent you are already viewing (where x types into its input), and "Enter to view" on the main row when main is already shown
zh: 修复 agent 面板底部在你已查看的 agent 上仍提示“Enter to view”和“x to stop”（此时 x 会输入到其输入框），以及主行已显示时仍提示“Enter to view”的问题
